entities.name: Blue Blanket
entities.description: Small basin with an ancient well in Sukurvia, named for the color of its stones; later buried by sand.

entities.name: Sukurvia
entities.description: Region in southwestern Jamuraa where the Blue Blanket lay.

entities.name: Sunken Sea
entities.description: Body of water the well was connected to.

entities.name: Blue Mountains
entities.description: Mountains whose color the hollow's stones recall.

events.summary: The Blue Blanket is eventually buried by the sands of Sukurvia and can no longer be found.
events.quote: the Blue Blanket was eventually buried by the sands of Sukurvia

relations.quote: The Blue Blanket was a small basin in Sukurvia in southwestern Jamuraa
